verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Workflows that automate ML pipelines with GPU instances (docs-9), and its REST API and CLI allow programmatic control (docs-23, docs-30). That means an external scheduler such as cron could trigger jobs, but the evidence never shows native scheduling or recurring triggers. Missing for 10: native cron or recurring schedule triggers for Workflows or jobs, documentation of how to schedule, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
